heroHeadline: CIA Whistleblower Alleges Lab Leak Intel Was Suppressed — WHO Recommends LP.8.1 for Next Vaccine
heroSubtitle: Senior CIA officer testified to Senate on May 13, 2026 that analysts' lab-leak findings were altered by leadership. WHO TAG-CO-VAC on May 16 recommended LP.8.1 as the next vaccine antigen as XFG.1.1 dominates globally. PABS treaty negotiations extended to July; U.S. pandemic preparedness capacity flagged as critically weakened.
footerNote: Data sourced from WHO, CDC, Our World in Data, The Lancet, Johns Hopkins CSSE, IMF, IATA, ILO, UNICEF, NIH RECOVER, Nature Immunology
